SELECT
  stn.name AS tag_name,
  COALESCE(a.cnt,0) AS tickets_last_6mo,
  COALESCE(b.cnt,0) AS tickets_prior_6mo,
  ROUND(COALESCE(a.cnt,0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(totals.total_a,0), 1) AS share_last_6mo_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(b.cnt,0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(totals.total_b,0), 1) AS share_prior_6mo_pct,
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(a.cnt,0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(totals.total_a,0)
    - COALESCE(b.cnt,0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(totals.total_b,0)
  , 1) AS share_change_pp,
  ROUND(a.avg_res_hours, 1) AS avg_resolution_hours_last_6mo
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM support_tags) stn
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT st.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.resolved_at - t.created_at)) / 3600.0) AS avg_res_hours
  FROM ticket_tags_map ttm
  JOIN tickets t ON t.id = ttm.ticket_id
  JOIN support_tags st ON st.id = ttm.support_tag_id
  WHERE t.created_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY st.name
) a ON a.name = stn.name
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT st.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM ticket_tags_map ttm
  JOIN tickets t ON t.id = ttm.ticket_id
  JOIN support_tags st ON st.id = ttm.support_tag_id
  WHERE t.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY st.name
) b ON b.name = stn.name
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_tags_map ttm JOIN tickets t ON t.id = ttm.ticket_id
       WHERE t.created_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01') AS total_a,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_tags_map ttm JOIN tickets t ON t.id = ttm.ticket_id
       WHERE t.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2025-07-01') AS total_b
) totals
WHERE COALESCE(a.cnt,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(b.cnt,0) > 0
ORDER BY tickets_last_6mo DESC, tag_name ASC
LIMIT 50
note: Grouped by support_tags.name across all tenants (tag names are only unique per tenant, so two merchants' same-named tag are merged into one row, per the request's "platform-level theme" framing). Each ticket counts once per tag it carries, so tag counts don't sum to total ticket volume; shares are of tagged ticket-tag rows, not of tickets. Periods use created_at >= start and < next-day-after-end to include the full inclusive date ranges.
